checkedAlternates.risk: Suez Canal connects the Red Sea to the Mediterranean.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Suez is a human-built artificial sea-level canal (group-2), unlike natural geological straits (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Bab el-Mandeb links to the Red Sea/Suez corridor.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Bab el-Mandeb separates Arabia and the Horn of Africa at the Indian Ocean entrance (group-4), not the Mediterranean/Black Sea basin (group-3).
